text:
Maya Choudhury: Heads-up — planning a coordinated flagday bump to v0.15.0 across API, runtime, console, and SDKs. Target window: this weekend. Quiet window (no user-facing deploys): Sat 02:00–06:00 UTC. Canaries should run inside the quiet window. Please confirm owners, post final PR URLs, and list any blockers.

Devin Park: API side: PR https://git.internal/redwood/api/pull/3421 is ready, still needs one more review (nullable header fix). I'll tag the release branch and push the image by Fri 18:00 UTC. No breaking changes.

Luca Romano: Runtime: we have a kernel-selection tweak that affects quantized paths. I want to run a canary first — plan: canary Sat 03:00–04:00 UTC (inside quiet window). Full rollout Sun 02:00 if canary green. Will open runtime PR and a canary run task. Note: update image tag format to `redwood/runtime:v0.15.0-kernel1`.

Sophia Chen: Console: PR https://git.internal/redwood/console/pull/539 created. UI flag to enable new model selector included. Changelog entry done and linked in the PR. I'll run smoke tests Fri 20:30 local -> staging.

release-bot: automated reminder: cutoff for release notes is Fri 20:00 UTC. Add `release-ready` label to PRs to be included. Canary scheduler: queued for Sat 03:00 UTC.

Maya Choudhury: Quick checklist I'm going to use — paste these in your PR descriptions: 
```
- bump to v0.15.0
- add changelog entry under /changelogs/0.15.0.md
- add `release-ready` label
- link the canary run id (if applicable)
```
Please post PR URLs by Fri 18:00 and mark any PRs that cannot be cut for this window. I'll cut the release candidate Fri 21:00 UTC and coordinate tag push.

Devin Park: Ack — will add `release-ready` and post final image digest here when pushed.

Luca Romano: Question — do SDKs need a protocol-major bump? Node SDK has a minor API rename (streaming options), I can add a shim to avoid a breaking bump, so should be fine. Will open SDK PRs by Fri 17:30.

Sophia Chen: Will add post-deploy smoke tests to the release checklist and ping QA. If runtime canary fails we'll rollback console flag immediately.

Maya Choudhury: Thanks — if anyone hits a hard blocker (build failures, compatibility mismatch) call it out here and ping me. Otherwise I'll consolidate changelog and cut the RC at Fri 21:00. :thumbsup:

Devin Park: quick note — command I'll run when cutting tag: `git tag -a v0.15.0 -m "v0.15.0 coordinated release" && git push origin v0.15.0`

release-bot: scheduled: create release candidate draft at Fri 21:00 UTC (ID: rc-2026-03-20-21).

Luca Romano: Will post runtime canary run id here once started.

Sophia Chen: CI flakiness checklist added to PRs — linking it now: https://git.internal/docs/release/ci-flaky-guidance

Maya Choudhury: Perfect. I'll check back Fri 18:30 for final PR list. Thanks all.
